sufficiency_note: Development starting material only. Qualify each new asset component and its scope independently.
purpose: Official retained interface examples plus a labelled synthetic asset scenario. All implementation and measurement remain pending.
original_acceptance: The minimum implementation consumes valid named inputs and meets the reviewed behavior cases; examples/templates alone do not establish completion.
Every mandatory artifact exists or maps to agreed equivalent sections; preserve original evidence and disclose unresolved failures.

Publish the specified baseline/metric results with denominators, measured/not-run state and limitations. A negative result may satisfy research acceptance if the protocol and artifact requirements are met.
Activation, authorization and existing platform boundaries remain enforced; no new owner, command or queue authority is introduced.
Named supporting reviewers reproduce the relevant contract/case check and record findings/disposition.

asset_research_plan.decision: One observed host–package–service relationship view for a narrow approved lab profile, with evidence references and explicit coverage. No inferred business-dependency graph is required.
questions: Which package/service/host relationships can the existing authorized collectors actually substantiate?
What is lost when observations are stale, one-sided, partial or scoped to one host?
Does an evidence-linked relationship view help reviewers answer asset-context questions compared with a flat inventory, at an acceptable resource cost?
Which smallest implementation answers the declared project need, and what evidence would make the extension unnecessary?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Use the same asset-context questions against flat inventory and the proposed relationship view; measure reviewer correctness/effort and source coverage. Disclose convenience-user limitations.
cases: A source explicitly relates a service to a package — An observed local relationship does not supply business-impact truth.
Only a network connection was observed — A connection alone cannot justify a confirmed business dependency.
The relationship evidence is stale — Keep history and current evidence status distinct.
consumers: D12 reviewer: optional observed asset context; Mahrous retains business-impact and prioritization policy.
Hams/UX02: optional evidence-linked context for interpretation and design; no automatic inferred dependency or risk claim.
Team scope review: enable/defer/reject decision with coverage and resource evidence.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous reviews context/priority boundaries; Hams reviews interpretation and the handoff to existing UX design.
asset_research_plan.start: Activate only for a concrete reviewed asset-context question that flat inventory does not answer well, after the core benchmark and capacity review. New probes require a separate approved capability.
